  1. Euclidean distance formula
    For two points

    pi=(Ti,Ci,Ri),pj=(Tj,Cj,Rj), p_i = (T_i, C_i, R_i), \quad p_j = (T_j, C_j, R_j),pi​=(Ti​,Ci​,Ri​),pj​=(Tj​,Cj​,Rj​),

    the Euclidean distance is

    d(pi,pj)=(Ti−Tj)2+(Ci−Cj)2+(Ri−Rj)2. d(p_i, p_j) = \sqrt{(T_i - T_j)^2 + (C_i - C_j)^2 + (R_i - R_j)^2}.d(pi​,pj​)=(Ti​−Tj​)2+(Ci​−Cj​)2+(Ri​−Rj​)2​.
